parameters.name: catalogItemId
parameters.description: Catalogue item id. An empty id or one longer than 128 characters can never name a resource and is a 404 not-found.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID per logical submit (1 to 128 printable ASCII characters); a retry reuses it. The same key with the same request (method, path, body) replays the stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed: true; the same key with another request is 409 idempotency-key-reused. Missing is 400 idempotency-key-required, malformed is 400 idempotency-key-invalid.
